title: TRN-042 forwarding stall is invisible to the alarm stream
derivation: After MODULE_INSERTED / LINK_UP on TRN-042 1/1/3 (network/alarms) every alarm is cleared, yet the PM samples show oper_status UP with in_octets_mbps < 0.01 for >= 60 min (telemetry). Only the context assertion explains it and gives the action: bounce the port.

title: A Kemi dispatch after 2026-08-03 needs the code lock, not Pekka's key
derivation: SEG-042 is flagged private_road (network/as_built/segments.json); the access assertion valid at the dispatch time says code lock since 2026-08-03 (recorded only on 2026-08-18).
